title: Senior Product Manager, Patient Onboarding
description:
**About Fernway Health**
Fernway is a virtual care company serving 900,000 Canadians through employer health plans. Our app connects members with family doctors, mental health therapists and pharmacists, usually in under an hour.

**The role**
We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own patient onboarding: everything from the first employer invite to a member's first completed visit. Today only 38% of invited members activate within 30 days. You'll own that number.

**What you'll do**
* Own the activation funnel across web, iOS and Android, from invite to first visit
* Lead a squad of 7 engineers, a product designer and a data analyst
* Run discovery with members, employers and clinicians to find where people get stuck
* Design and ship experiments; build the measurement plan before you build the feature
* Partner with Privacy and Clinical Governance on consent, identity and health-card verification
* Present quarterly results and roadmap to the VP Product and our employer partnerships team

**What we're looking for**
* 6+ years of product management, with at least 2 owning a growth, onboarding or activation metric
* Experience in a regulated industry (health, financial services, insurance)
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable in SQL and Amplitude or Mixpanel
* Clear, concise writing; you'd rather send a one-page memo than a 40-slide deck
* Bonus: experience with identity verification, consent flows or a Privacy Impact Assessment

**Compensation and benefits**
Base salary $150,000 to $175,000 plus stock options, full health and dental from day one, $1,500 home office budget and a $2,000 annual learning budget. Fully remote across Canada with two team offsites a year.

title: Senior Product Manager, Payments Onboarding
description:
**Who we are**
Cobalt Ledger builds payments and accounts-payable software for 40,000 Canadian small and mid-sized businesses. We process over $9B a year and we're growing 60% year over year.

**About the role**
Merchants who finish onboarding in their first week stay for years. Merchants who stall rarely come back. As Senior Product Manager, Payments Onboarding you'll own the path from sign-up to first payment processed, including KYB (know your business) checks, bank verification and risk review.

**You will**
* Own time-to-first-payment and onboarding completion for new merchants
* Work with Risk and Compliance to make KYB fast without increasing fraud losses
* Lead a cross-functional team of engineering, design, data and operations
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success on assisted onboarding for larger accounts
* Turn qualitative research and funnel data into a clear, prioritized roadmap

**You have**
* 5+ years in product management, ideally in fintech, payments or B2B SaaS
* A track record of moving a conversion or activation metric, and you can explain how
* Comfort working with risk, compliance or legal partners in a regulated space
* Strong data skills (SQL a plus) and an experimentation mindset

**Details**
Hybrid: 2 days a week at our King West office. Base salary $145,000 to $170,000, annual bonus up to 10%, equity, RRSP matching and 4 weeks of vacation.

title: Senior Product Manager, Digital Claims
description:
**About Tidewater Mutual**
Tidewater is a 120-year-old mutual insurer protecting 2 million Canadian homes and vehicles. We're three years into a digital transformation and we're investing heavily in self-serve claims.

**The opportunity**
When something goes wrong, our customers want answers fast. As Senior Product Manager, Digital Claims, you'll own the digital claims journey for home and auto: first notice of loss, document upload, status tracking and payment.

**Responsibilities**
* Set the vision and 18-month roadmap for digital claims, aligned to business outcomes
* Grow digital claim submission from 31% to 60% while improving customer satisfaction
* Lead two agile squads and work closely with Claims Operations, IT, and our core claims system vendor
* Own launches end to end, including go-live readiness and hypercare
* Build business cases and report progress to the Claims leadership team

**Qualifications**
* 6+ years of product management experience, including customer-facing digital products
* Insurance or financial services experience strongly preferred
* Experience managing vendors and integrating with core systems
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority

**What we offer**
Base salary $155,000 to $180,000, 15% target bonus, defined-benefit pension, flexible hybrid work (1 to 2 days a week in our Toronto office) and a strong commitment to work-life balance.

title: Product Operations Lead
companyIndustry: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
description:
**About us**
Brightline Freight is a digital freight brokerage connecting 15,000 carriers with shippers across North America. Our product team has grown from 4 to 9 PMs in a year and we need operational backbone.

**The role**
As our first Product Operations Lead you'll build the systems that help our product team plan, ship and learn faster.

**What you'll own**
* Quarterly planning and roadmap process across 9 product squads
* Launch process: readiness checklists, release notes, enablement for Sales and Carrier Support
* Product metrics: a single source of truth for adoption and feature usage
* Voice of customer: a pipeline that turns support tickets and sales calls into insights
* Tooling: Jira, Productboard, Amplitude and our internal wiki

**About you**
* 5+ years in product management, product operations, or strategy and operations
* You love process only when it makes teams faster
* Strong analytical skills and comfort building dashboards
* Excellent written communication

**Compensation**
$125,000 to $145,000 base, bonus, health benefits and a fully remote team across Canada.

title: Growth Product Manager
description:
**Pinecrest** makes scheduling software for independent fitness studios. We're a profitable, bootstrapped team of 45.

**The role**
We're hiring our first Growth Product Manager to own self-serve acquisition and activation. You'll work with two engineers, a designer and our marketing lead.

**You'll**
* Own the trial funnel: sign-up, setup, first class booked, paid conversion
* Run a steady cadence of experiments on onboarding, pricing pages and lifecycle emails
* Build dashboards and share weekly learnings with the company
* Talk to studio owners every week

**You bring**
* 3+ years of product or growth experience in B2B SaaS
* Hands-on with analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar) and basic SQL
* A bias for shipping small and learning fast

**Pay and perks**
$110,000 to $125,000 base, profit sharing, 4-day work week in summer, fully remote.

title: Product Manager, AI Tutor
description:
**About Lumen**
Lumen builds study tools used by 3 million high school and college students. Our AI tutor launched last year and is now our fastest-growing product.

**The role**
You'll own the AI Tutor experience: how students ask questions, how the tutor explains, and how we measure whether students actually learn.

**Responsibilities**
* Define product strategy and quality bar for an LLM-powered tutor
* Partner with ML engineers on evaluation, prompt design and guardrails
* Run user research with students and teachers
* Track engagement, retention and learning outcomes

**Requirements**
* 4+ years of product management experience
* Hands-on experience shipping LLM or AI features
* Strong analytical skills and a passion for education

**Compensation**
USD $130,000 to $150,000, equity, remote across the US and Canada.

title: Product Manager, Small Business Banking
description:
**About Northbeam**
Northbeam is a digital-first Canadian bank with 600,000 clients and no branches. We're expanding into small business banking.

**The role**
As Product Manager, Small Business Banking, you'll help launch our business chequing account and the onboarding experience behind it.

**What you'll do**
* Own the business account opening journey, including KYB and beneficial ownership checks
* Work with Compliance, Operations and Engineering to design a fast, compliant flow
* Define launch metrics and run a pilot with 500 businesses
* Gather feedback from small business owners and accountants

**What you'll need**
* 4+ years of product management in banking or fintech
* Experience with digital onboarding, KYC or KYB
* Strong stakeholder management and clear writing
* Data-informed decision making; SQL is an asset

**Why Northbeam**
$125,000 to $150,000 base, bonus, hybrid work (2 days a week downtown Toronto) and a fast-moving team.

title: Senior Product Manager, Employee Onboarding
description:
**Aurora Payroll** runs payroll and HR for 12,000 Canadian employers.

**About the role**
New hires should be ready to work, and paid correctly, on day one. You'll own the employee onboarding product: offer acceptance, e-signature of documents, tax forms (TD1), direct deposit and benefits enrolment.

**Responsibilities**
* Own onboarding completion and time-to-first-paycheque metrics
* Lead a squad of 6 engineers and a designer
* Partner with Legal on e-signature and document retention requirements
* Work with Customer Success to cut onboarding-related support tickets

**About you**
* 6+ years of product management in B2B SaaS, HR tech or fintech
* Experience owning a self-serve flow with measurable conversion
* Comfortable with compliance-heavy domains
* Excellent written and verbal communication

**Compensation**
$140,000 to $160,000 base, stock options, fully remote in Canada.

title: Senior Product Manager, Rider Growth
description:
**Kestrel** operates e-bike and e-scooter sharing in 14 Canadian cities.

**The role**
You'll own rider growth: acquisition, first ride and the habit loop that turns a curious first-timer into a weekly rider.

**You will**
* Own new-rider activation and 30-day retention
* Run experiments across the app, referral program, pricing passes and lifecycle messaging
* Partner with Marketing, Data Science and City Operations
* Build the growth model and present it to leadership monthly

**You have**
* 6+ years in product, with deep growth or lifecycle experience in a consumer app
* Strong quantitative skills; comfortable with SQL and experiment design
* Experience with pricing or subscription products is a plus

**Perks**
$150,000 to $170,000 base, equity, free rides, hybrid (3 days a week in our Liberty Village office).

title: Product Manager, Merchant Activation
description:
**Saltbox** gives independent retailers an online store and point of sale in one.

**The role**
Most merchants who don't make a sale in their first 14 days churn. You'll own merchant activation: setup, catalogue import, payments, first sale.

**What you'll do**
* Own the activation funnel and the 14-day first-sale rate
* Ship guided setup, templates and smart defaults
* Run experiments with lifecycle marketing
* Partner with Support to find and remove setup blockers

**What we're looking for**
* 4+ years of product management in SaaS or e-commerce
* Track record improving activation or conversion
* Comfortable with Amplitude/Mixpanel and SQL

**Compensation**
$130,000 to $145,000 base plus equity, fully remote across Canada.

title: Product Owner, Member Portal
description:
**Granite Health Plans** administers group health and dental benefits for 1,800 Canadian employers.

**About the role**
Our Product Owner, Member Portal will own the web and mobile experience members use to submit claims, check coverage and find providers.

**Key responsibilities**
* Own and prioritize the member portal backlog for one agile team
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria
* Work with Claims Operations and IT to improve digital claim adoption
* Track and report digital adoption metrics

**Qualifications**
* 4+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager
* Health benefits or insurance experience preferred
* Agile delivery experience (Scrum, Jira)
* CSPO or similar certification an asset

**What we offer**
$115,000 to $135,000, bonus, comprehensive benefits, hybrid (2 days a week in office).

title: Product Manager, Workflow Automation
description:
**Quill** helps 3,000 law firms automate intake, conflict checks and document assembly.

**The role**
You'll own our workflow automation product, including the new AI drafting assistant that turns intake answers into first-draft documents.

**What you'll do**
* Own the automation builder and AI drafting roadmap
* Run discovery with lawyers, law clerks and firm administrators
* Partner with engineering on AI quality evaluation and guardrails
* Measure time saved per matter and adoption across firms

**What you bring**
* 5+ years of product management in B2B SaaS
* Experience shipping AI or automation features
* Comfort working in regulated, risk-sensitive domains
* Daily user of AI tools yourself

**Compensation**
$135,000 to $155,000 base, equity, fully remote in Canada.

title: Senior Product Manager, Digital Advice
description:
**About Clearpath Wealth**
Clearpath manages $14B for 250,000 Canadian investors through a mix of digital tools and human advisors.

**The role**
You'll own the digital advice experience: goal setting, risk profiling, account opening and the hand-off to an advisor when clients want one.

**What you'll do**
* Own conversion from prospect to funded account, and assets gathered in the first 90 days
* Lead two cross-functional squads
* Work with Compliance on suitability and KYC requirements
* Use research and experimentation to simplify a complex, regulated journey
* Build business cases and present to the executive team

**What you'll bring**
* 7+ years of product management, ideally in wealth, banking or insurance
* Experience owning a regulated digital onboarding or account opening flow
* Strong analytical and storytelling skills
* Experience partnering with Legal, Compliance and Risk

**Compensation**
$150,000 to $175,000 base, 15% bonus, RRSP matching, hybrid (2 days a week, Bay Street).

title: Senior Product Manager, Product-Led Growth
description:
**Fieldnote** is a customer research platform used by 8,000 product and UX teams.

**The role**
We're moving from sales-led to product-led growth. You'll own the self-serve motion end to end: free plan, activation, upgrade and expansion.

**Responsibilities**
* Own free-to-paid conversion and net revenue retention for self-serve accounts
* Design the activation journey and in-product upgrade moments
* Partner with Marketing, Sales and Data on the PLG funnel and product-qualified leads
* Run pricing and packaging experiments

**About you**
* 6+ years of product management in B2B SaaS
* Hands-on PLG or growth experience with measurable results
* Fluent in product analytics (Amplitude or similar) and SQL
* Experience with pricing and packaging

**Pay**
$145,000 to $165,000 base, equity, fully remote in Canada.

title: Product Manager, Policy Self-Serve
description:
**Riverstone Insurance** protects 700,000 Ontario drivers and homeowners.

**About the role**
You'll own policy self-serve: how customers change a vehicle, update an address, add a driver or download a pink slip without calling us.

**You will**
* Grow self-serve policy changes and reduce contact-centre volume
* Lead an agile team and own the backlog and roadmap
* Partner with Underwriting, Operations and IT
* Launch new capabilities and manage go-live with operations teams

**You have**
* 4+ years of product management, insurance strongly preferred
* Experience with digital self-serve and contact-centre deflection
* Strong stakeholder management

**We offer**
$120,000 to $140,000, bonus, pension, hybrid (2 days a week in Waterloo).

title: Senior Product Manager, Customer Onboarding
description:
**Copperline** provides internet and mobile service to 2.3 million Canadians.

**The role**
You'll own the digital onboarding journey for new internet and mobile customers: plan selection, credit check, ordering, installation booking and first bill.

**Responsibilities**
* Own online order completion and first-30-day contact rate
* Lead cross-functional squads across digital, IT and field operations
* Use journey analytics and research to find and fix friction
* Build business cases and secure investment

**Qualifications**
* 6+ years of product management for high-volume consumer journeys
* Experience with onboarding, e-commerce checkout or account opening
* Strong analytical skills and executive presence

**Compensation**
$140,000 to $160,000 base, 12% bonus, hybrid (3 days a week at our Toronto campus).
